description: House Minority Leader Tony McCombie (Savanna) and members of the Illinois House Republican Caucus hosted 50 women leaders from across the state on Tuesday to recognize the difference they are making in communities throughout Illinois in their chosen fields of education, business, social services, health care, volunteerism and a wide range of other areas.
